contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE ; D/ DN GRATIAN [..]

Copper alloy Nummus of Gratian (Reece Period 19). Reverse legend reads: SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE. Reverse: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Mint is unclear , AD 367-375. Obverse legend reads: DN GRATIAN [..]. Obverse: Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis: 6 o'clock
